The assistant’s answer is incorrect. The inequality |x + 5| < 10 should be solved as –10 < x + 5 < 10, giving –15 < x < 5, which contains 19 integers (–14 to 4). The assistant mistakenly rewrote the inequality as |x| < 5 and counted only four integers, so the response is inaccurate and unhelpful.
